answer: The timber index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 236 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the bridge. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the anchor queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. A 452 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
